name: Clean Hotbar - Flat Minimal HUD
summary: Replaces the vanilla hotbar and XP bar with a flat design that is easier to read at a glance.
body:
**Clean Hotbar - Flat Minimal HUD** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- The hotbar is redrawn as flat dark slots with a thin outline - all 9 slots kept
- The slot selector is a clean white frame instead of the vanilla arrow marker
- The XP bar gets a dark track and a bright green fill

### Why players use it
- Less visual noise on the bottom of your screen while keeping every vanilla function
- Easier to read your XP level and your items quickly during a fight

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)
